test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: G, H, I, J, K and L are six friends sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table discussing the outcome of a cricket match. I is an immediate neighbour of both L and J. K is not the immediate neighbour of J. H is seated second to the left of L. Which of the following options represents I's position from G?
solution:
G, H, I, J, K and L are six friends sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) H is seated second to the left of L

\ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3b1573d0b9c30db9feaef9b4413c82605bc7a7804eea619b90cc84f154147ab.png] 

2) I is an immediate neighbour of both L and J. 

3) K is not the immediate neighbour of J. 

\ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f27b9a52c0c4991205fcbfe949dca1c9349ddf14a37fbb6e1b0ddc5e369f1c92.png] 

 I's position from G is **Second to the left.**

Hence, the** correct answer** is** "Option 1"**
